title: fix(web): list only triage-enabled repositories in All open
body:
All open reused the open pull request set, which covers every connected repository so the Repositories page can show counts, and so listed pull requests from repositories where triage is off. All open and its rail count now include only repositories with triage enabled, through one pure filter; Needs you and the Repositories page are unchanged, and toggling triage updates the view from the shared config without a reload.

Verified: `bun run check`; web tests: a disabled repository's pull requests are dropped and enabled ones kept, the All open count follows the enabled set, the Needs you count is unchanged.

Refs CL-XXXX
author: TheGreatAxios
commits: fix(web): list only triage-enabled repositories in All open
